culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Mamiko Hirasawa. She is revealed to be the daughter of Yuji Okabe, who killed himself after losing his title of chicken sexing champion at the hands of Nanba who revealed to have been cheating all along. Conan, as Kogoro, revealed that he had figured this out after watching the footage of the fateful day when Yuji Okabe had been cheated of his chicken sexer title. It was pretty obvious from the footage that he was in cahoots with Kusano who had rigged all the matches so that Nanba would win every single time.
